subject: Hospitality
title: HACCP: Safety as System
description: A micro-lesson that makes HACCP: Safety as System usable.

hook.text: HACCP—Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points—was developed for NASA astronauts.

buildup.text: HACCP identifies every point where food could become unsafe: receiving, storage, prep, cooking, holding, and serving.

discovery.text: Critical control points have strict limits. Chicken must reach 74°C internally. Cold storage must stay below 4°C. No exceptions.

twist.text: A single foodborne illness outbreak can cost a restaurant $75,000 in lawsuits, lost revenue, and brand damage.

climax.text: Digital temperature monitoring now automates HACCP logs. Sensors alert staff when a fridge rises above safe limits.

punchline.text: Built for astronauts, essential for kitchens. HACCP makes food safety systematic.

quiz.question: What was HACCP originally developed for?
options: NASA astronaut food—ensuring safety in space
